name: Floral Bloom
description: A beautifully crafted floral wedding e-invite bathed in soft blush pinks and rose golds. Watercolor-style floral borders of peonies, roses, and jasmine frame the invitation with a delicate, romantic touch. Perfect for couples who love a soft, dreamy aesthetic. Features envelope animation, event itinerary, and a photo gallery.
